messages:
amanda: kicking off config-only rollout now. targeting routing-policy + batching tweaks (canary 5% for 20m). watching p95, errors, kvcache. deploy-bot: rollout started (job=6789) canary=5% window=20m :rocket:

deploy-bot: config diff:
```
route.policy: cost-aware -> cost-v2
batch.max_tokens: 256 -> 512
request.timeout_ms: 1000 -> 1200
enterprise.route.pin: false
```

josh: pushing those flags. note: batch.max_tokens = 512 to reduce caller-side tail, but could increase kvcache pressure. :eyes:

sanjay: acknowledged. i'll watch kvcache_miss, p95, and error_rate. set alerts: p95>1200ms OR errors > 0.8%

maya: adding this to release notes (config-only). callout: no model/version change, but we will pin legacy-route for enterprise if needed.

ops-watch: alert on canary cluster: p95 rose to 1500ms, error_rate +0.8% (baseline 0.2%), kvcache_miss +12%. tagging with :warning:.

amanda: pausing rollout. holding at canary. do not advance to prod. hypothesis: batch increase causing kvcache churn and higher p95.

deploy-bot: paused rollout (job=6789) status=held. initiating targeted rollback of routing-policy in canary only.

amanda: apply routing-policy rollback for canary, but keep batch tweak in staging for more testing. small rollback by routing weight only.

deploy-bot: rollback applied to canary routing-policy (job=6790). canary routing weight reverted -> 0.0 for cost-v2. batch config still present in staging.

josh: opened a quick change: add service flag `routing.v2.enable` = false for enterprise-* namespaces and created a short PR to pin legacy route for those customers. link: https://git.internal/r/1234

maya: will update customer-facing notes and ping CS + solutions about the hold.

sanjay: next steps: run ablation between batch.max_tokens 256 vs 512 on canary-only infra; run KV cache warmup experiment; instrument per-route cache hit metrics. if regressions persist, schedule an emergency rollback plan for batch param.

amanda: agreed. action items: 1) josh -> run ablation tests (30m), 2) sanjay -> KV warmup script + metrics, 3) maya -> update release notes + CS ping, 4) i'll schedule 10:30 sync. If canary stabilizes after routing rollback, we may re-evaluate batch param at 10:45. :white_check_mark:

ops-watch: logging incident note. severity=low for now, but watch window extended to 40m.

deploy-bot: final status: routing rollback applied to canary, rollout paused. will resume only after manual GO from amanda or 2 consecutive 10m windows with p95 < 1200ms and errors < 0.5%.

amanda: thanks all. keeping thread open for updates. :handshake:
